## Cuartiles de distribuciones asimétricas

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5.2

par(
  mfrow = c(1,2),
  mar = c(4.5,4.5,3,1),
  family = "sans"
)

# =========================
# Distribución Exponencial
# =========================

lambda <- 0.3

x1 <- seq(0, 20, length = 600)
fx1 <- dexp(x1, lambda)

q_exp <- qexp(c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75), lambda)
media_exp <- 1/lambda

plot(
  x1, fx1,
  type = "n",
  ylim = c(0, max(fx1)*1.15),
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "f(x)",
  main = "Cuartiles: Exponencial(0.3)",
  cex.main = 1.3,
  cex.lab = 1.1
)

grid(col = "gray90")

polygon(
  c(0, x1, max(x1)),
  c(0, fx1, 0),
  col = adjustcolor("#bfdbfe", alpha.f = 0.55),
  border = NA
)

lines(
  x1, fx1,
  lwd = 4,
  col = "#1e3a8a"
)

cols <- c("#f59e0b", "#166534", "#f59e0b")
labs <- c("Q1", "Mediana", "Q3")

for(i in 1:3){

  abline(
    v = q_exp[i],
    col = cols[i],
    lwd = 2.5,
    lty = 2
  )

  points(
    q_exp[i],
    dexp(q_exp[i], lambda),
    pch = 19,
    cex = 1.3,
    col = cols[i]
  )
}

# Media
abline(
  v = media_exp,
  col = "#991b1b",
  lwd = 2.5,
  lty = 3
)

text(
  media_exp + 0.4,
  max(fx1)*0.85,
  "Media",
  col = "#991b1b",
  cex = 1,
  font = 2
)

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("Q1", "Mediana", "Q3", "Media"),
  col = c("#f59e0b", "#166534",
          "#f59e0b", "#991b1b"),
  lwd = c(2.5,2.5,2.5,2.5),
  lty = c(2,2,2,3),
  bty = "n",
  cex = 0.95
)

# ====================
# Distribución Gamma
# ====================

alpha <- 2
beta <- 2

x2 <- seq(0, 20, length = 600)
fx2 <- dgamma(x2, alpha, scale = beta)

q_gamma <- qgamma(c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75),
                  alpha, scale = beta)

media_gamma <- alpha * beta

plot(
  x2, fx2,
  type = "n",
  ylim = c(0, max(fx2)*1.15),
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "f(x)",
  main = "Cuartiles: Gamma(2,2)",
  cex.main = 1.3,
  cex.lab = 1.1
)

grid(col = "gray90")

polygon(
  c(0, x2, max(x2)),
  c(0, fx2, 0),
  col = adjustcolor("#bbf7d0", alpha.f = 0.6),
  border = NA
)

lines(
  x2, fx2,
  lwd = 4,
  col = "#166534"
)

cols2 <- c("#f59e0b", "#1e3a8a", "#f59e0b")

for(i in 1:3){

  abline(
    v = q_gamma[i],
    col = cols2[i],
    lwd = 2.5,
    lty = 2
  )

  points(
    q_gamma[i],
    dgamma(q_gamma[i], alpha, scale = beta),
    pch = 19,
    cex = 1.3,
    col = cols2[i]
  )
}

# Media
abline(
  v = media_gamma,
  col = "#991b1b",
  lwd = 2.5,
  lty = 3
)

text(
  media_gamma + 0.4,
  max(fx2)*0.85,
  "Media",
  col = "#991b1b",
  cex = 1,
  font = 2
)

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("Q1", "Mediana", "Q3", "Media"),
  col = c("#f59e0b", "#1e3a8a",
          "#f59e0b", "#991b1b"),
  lwd = c(2.5,2.5,2.5,2.5),
  lty = c(2,2,2,3),
  bty = "n",
  cex = 0.95
)
```
